mocks.title: 冬のさんぽ — 横歩きアニメーション
mocks.summary: 8コマの女の子と、左へ流れる雪の森。歩く速さを変えて眺める冬のアニメーション。
principles: 元画像の歩行を保つ
背景の速度差で奥行きを表す
歩行と景色を同時に止める

mocks.title: しろい散歩 — Snowbound
mocks.summary: スプライトの女の子と雪の森を散歩。足跡、降雪、風と足音、小屋や凍った池をめぐるスマホ向けの小さな冬。
principles: Let movement leave a trace
Keep the world within thumb reach
Preserve sprite whites

mocks.title: PAPER MOON — Pocket Papercraft Café
mocks.summary: 余白を、ひとくち。紙の3Dカフェで時間と光を変え、一杯を淹れてポストカードに残す、スマホ向けの小さな体験。
principles: One small world, one complete experience
Frame the world for the screen, not the other way around
Let every interaction leave a little meaning

mocks.title: daybook — Superr Style Study
mocks.summary: Refero / Superr の design grammar を抽出し、架空の notebook brand へ翻訳した最初の study。
principles: Preserve color roles, not only values
Object-first composition
Extreme typography creates identity

mocks.title: daybook — Cardless Notebook
mocks.summary: カードを禁止し、罫線・余白・手書き注釈とスクロール描画で notebook 自体を layout system にした study。
principles: Less dashboard, more margin
Scroll behaves like a pen
Use a shared sight line for writing

mocks.title: The Ridiculous Daily — Fake Newspaper
mocks.summary: 新聞の硬派な編集レイアウトをそのまま使い、猫市長・先延ばし遺伝子・月の接近禁止命令など、とんでもない擬似ニュースだけを真顔で掲載する study。
principles: Make nonsense look institutionally serious
Density is part of the aesthetic
Tiny believable metadata sells the fiction

mocks.title: Orbit — Dark Constellation
mocks.summary: 純黒の余白・巨大なregular-weight typography・紫の単一CTA・三角形particle constellationを使い、散らばった思考同士をつなぐ架空のcollective-memoryサービスへ翻訳した study。
principles: The void is the design
Scale before weight
One visual signature beats many illustrations

mocks.title: Frameflow — Bright Paper Motion Studio
mocks.summary: Lottielabのbright-paper editor grammarを使い、プレビュー・再生ヘッド・キーフレームが同期して動く架空のanimation studioへ展開したモーション study。
principles: The editor stays still; the authored object moves
Timeline and preview tell the same story
One chromatic actor per viewport

mocks.title: Glass Lab — Apple-style Material Study
mocks.summary: Apple系の白・薄灰・青アクセントを土台に、Nav / Dock / Control Center / Modal / Lens / Notificationの6種類のforeground glass UIを比較・操作できるmaterial study。
principles: Glass is a foreground layer, not a theme
The background is part of the material
Blur, edge light and context matter more than transparency

mocks.title: AERO — Apple Fluid Interaction Study
mocks.summary: Apple Design skillの思想をbehavior-firstでWebへ落とし込み、1:1 drag・velocity handoff・momentum projection・interruptible spring・rubber-band・glass sheetを実際に触れる架空product siteとして実装したstudy。
principles: Motion is response, not a clip
Preserve velocity across gesture and spring
Every gesture-driven animation stays interruptible

mocks.title: PRISM TRANSIT — Spatial Cube Study
mocks.summary: Vivid-likeなdark monochrome + RGB prism grammarを、固定Cubeをwaypointとして1つのworld/camera経路で通過するcamera-first spatial transitへ翻訳したstudy。
principles: Keep landmarks fixed and move the viewpoint
Render only while motion is settling
RGB belongs to optics, not interface chrome

mocks.title: PRISM ORBIT — Fluid Camera Cube Study
mocks.summary: 1つのCubeを中心に、縦scroll=distance・横swipe=orbit・tap=face detailsを分離し、velocity handoff・90°snap・interruptible springで安心感のある空間操作を試すstudy。
principles: One gesture owns one spatial meaning
Free manipulation settles into stable semantic faces
Put spectacle in the world and predictability in the controls

mocks.title: PRISM INTERIOR — Read the Room Study
mocks.summary: Cube内部にカメラを置き、4つの壁そのものを情報面にするstudy。横swipeで視点を90°ずつ移し、settle後にDaybook由来の左→右writing motionで壁へ文章が現れる。
principles: Bind content to stable geometry
Orient first, explain second
Four semantic walls beat six equal directions

mocks.title: FOLD — Steep Spatial Card Curtain
mocks.summary: Steepのeditorial floating artifactsを、前面カードを大きく・背面カードを小さく重ねるspatial curtainへ展開。Apple Fluidの1:1 drag・velocity handoff・momentum・interruptible springと、Daybookのsettle後writingを組み合わせたstudy。
principles: Spatial hierarchy can express selection
Preserve velocity through card selection
Settle the container before animating dense internals

mocks.title: TIDE — Auros Bioluminescent Liquid Mass
mocks.summary: Aurosの深海teal surface stackとbioluminescent orbを、Apple Fluidのdirect manipulationへ展開。外殻は即応、内部particle massは遅延、release velocityを保ったままsurface tensionで復元する液体反応study。
principles: Liquid response can come from layered inertia
Preserve velocity into shape restoration
Let disturbance create fluid motion instead of an idle loop

mocks.title: DIAL — Apple Fluid Tuning Lab
mocks.summary: DialKitをno-buildの静的UI LabへReact islandとして追加し、Apple Fluidのgesture response・spatial depth・Soft Clear materialを実機上でリアルタイム調整するtooling study。
principles: Find the feel before the numbers
Tune perceptual groups, not arbitrary CSS properties
Keep the tuning layer separate from product UI

mocks.title: AFTERHOURS RUN CLUB
mocks.summary: 黒とアシッドグリーン、夜のランニング写真、大型タイポグラフィで構成したモバイルファーストの架空ランニングコミュニティ study。
principles: Atmosphere first, then the next run
Use green for action and selected state
Recompose the page for phones instead of shrinking desktop

mocks.title: Blue Slime Playground
mocks.summary: 青いスライムを直接つかみ、伸ばし、離した勢いまで表面変形へつなぐ、タッチ中心の3Dインタラクション study。
principles: Make the first interaction obvious without a tutorial
Preserve release velocity into deformation
Recompose the camera for narrow screens

mocks.title: Once Upon a Cup
mocks.summary: 開いた本の中の紙カフェを中心に、3D探索・3つの視点・昼夕の切替を静かな編集レイアウトへまとめた café story study。
principles: Make the finished composition useful before 3D loads
Let the model carry the visual detail
Reframe by viewport aspect instead of shrinking a desktop camera
